The Business Research Company’s Competitive Analysis of Artificial Intelligence Global Market Report 2026 – Market Size, Trends, And Forecast 2026-2035

LONDON, GREATER LONDON , UNITED KINGDOM, October 26, 2026 /EINPresswire.com/ -- The rapid incorporation of artificial intelligence (AI) into urban development is revolutionizing how cities operate and serve their residents. As smart cities evolve, AI applications are playing an increasingly pivotal role in managing infrastructure, resources, and public services efficiently. Examining current market trends and forecasts offers insight into the dynamic growth and opportunities within this sector.

Market Size and Position of Artificial Intelligence Applications for Smart Cities The artificial intelligence (AI) applications for smart cities market is anticipated to exceed $40 billion by 2030. This market is a subset of the broader Smart Cities industry, which is projected to reach around $2,210 billion by the same year. AI applications will represent roughly 2% of that parent market. Within the larger Information Technology sector, expected to be valued at $13,788 billion by 2030, the AI for smart cities segment will make up approximately 0.3% of the total market.

North America as the Leading Region in AI for Smart Cities by 2030 By 2030, North America is set to be the largest regional market for artificial intelligence applications in smart cities, valued at $14.9 billion. The market value is expected to grow from $6.3 billion in 2025, demonstrating a strong compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 19%. This expansion is driven by widespread adoption of AI-enabled urban management tools, increased investments to upgrade smart infrastructure, deployment of connected sensors, enhanced digital public services, and collaborative efforts among technology vendors, governments, and research bodies to advance smart city initiatives in the region.

Dominant Country in the AI for Smart Cities Market: The United States The United States is projected to dominate the global AI applications market for smart cities by 2030, with an estimated worth of $13.2 billion. This growth stems from its market size of $5.6 billion in 2025, growing at a CAGR of 19%. Key factors include extensive use of AI-driven traffic and public safety systems, increased investments in intelligent transportation and digital infrastructure, growing reliance on predictive analytics for city operations, greater demand for real-time municipal decision-making, and continuous innovation by leading technology firms aiming to optimize urban efficiency and enhance citizen experiences.

Leading Segment within the AI Applications for Smart Cities Market When broken down by type, the market segments into safety and security, mobility and transportation, energy and resource management, infrastructure management, and healthcare. The mobility and transportation segment is expected to be the largest, accounting for 32% of the market or $13 billion in 2030. Growth in this segment will be fueled by the adoption of AI-powered traffic management platforms, connected and autonomous mobility solutions, real-time public transit optimization, smart parking and congestion systems, and ongoing investments in smart mobility ecosystems designed to improve transport efficiency and reduce pollution in urban areas.

Technology and Deployment Segments in the AI for Smart Cities Market The market is categorized by deployment methods into cloud-based and on-premises solutions. Additionally, it is segmented by technology into machine learning, computer vision, IoT integration, and big data analytics. Application-wise, the market covers both big cities and medium/small cities, each with unique demands and growth potentials.

Expected Growth Rate Through 2030 The artificial intelligence applications for smart cities market is forecasted to expand at an impressive compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 20% leading up to 2030, reflecting rapid acceptance and integration of AI-driven urban solutions globally.

Primary Factors Fueling Market Expansion Rising Urbanization and Population Density One of the strongest drivers behind market growth is the increasing urbanization and population density worldwide. As metropolitan areas expand, there is greater demand for intelligent digital platforms that can coordinate complex city functions such as transportation networks, utility management, emergency responses, and public infrastructure. AI-powered analytics equip city officials with the tools to monitor urban activities, predict service needs, and boost operational efficiency, particularly in densely populated environments. The complexity of managing modern cities encourages municipalities to implement sophisticated AI solutions to enhance responsiveness and facilitate long-term urban planning. This factor alone is expected to add about 2.0% annual growth to the market.

Government Support Through Smart City Initiatives Public sector investments in smart city development programs also significantly contribute to market growth. Governments worldwide are increasingly funding digital transformation efforts aimed at modernizing civic infrastructure using intelligent technologies and connected platforms. AI adoption is accelerating to improve administrative operations, enhance public services, and enable data-driven governance within urban ecosystems. These well-funded, strategic projects are facilitating the rollout of advanced AI capabilities in municipal functions, contributing approximately 1.5% annual growth to the market.

Sustainability Needs Driving AI Use in Urban Environments Another key growth catalyst is the growing emphasis on sustainable resource management. Cities are under pressure to optimize energy and resource use, and AI technologies are instrumental in achieving these goals through intelligent monitoring, forecasting, and automated adjustments. By identifying inefficiencies and enabling proactive management of urban assets, AI solutions help municipalities meet sustainability targets while reducing operational expenses. As cities prioritize environmentally responsible development and resilience, adoption of AI-enabled resource management platforms is predicted to add roughly 1.3% per year to market growth.
